**Skill Name**
The name of your skill (lowercase-hyphenated).

**Description**
A one-line description of what the skill does.

**Category**
Which category does this skill belong to?
- [ ] Frontend Development
- [ ] Backend Development
- [ ] Mobile & Cross-Platform
- [ ] Database & Data
- [ ] AI & Machine Learning
- [ ] DevOps & Infrastructure
- [ ] Cloud Platforms
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Testing
- [ ] Design & UI/UX
- [ ] API Development
- [ ] Authentication & Auth
- [ ] Content & SEO
- [ ] Other (please specify)

**What Problem Does It Solve?**
Explain what task or problem this skill helps with.

**How Is It Different From Existing Skills?**
If there are similar skills, how does yours differ?

**Checklist**
- [ ] I have created a folder in `skills/` with a lowercase-hyphenated name
- [ ] My `SKILL.md` includes proper frontmatter (name, description, source, date_added)
- [ ] The skill includes clear step-by-step instructions
- [ ] The skill includes examples
- [ ] The skill includes best practices
- [ ] I have tested the skill with an AI coding assistant

**Additional Notes**
Any other information or context.
